principle: Lagos Nigeria is the reference implementation; other places named Lagos become comparative deployment grids only after the Nigeria evidence package is validated.

grids.name: Dos Lagos
grids.note: Dos Lagos is not unique enough to assign a deployment geography without an explicit city/country. Resolve before creating a geographic pilot record.

remaining_lagos.discovery_method: country-aware gazetteer plus authoritative municipal sources
remaining_lagos.rule: No place is added to the deployment grid solely because its name contains Lagos; each location requires geographic disambiguation and an authoritative source.

sequencing: publish controlled Global Lagos Nigeria evidence package
perform local regulatory and water-resource assessment
establish local measurement and DMRV adapters
